title: Hatsune Miku — Miku Miku ☆ Gunner!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where could those two be? I can't wait for them to get here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, are you waiting for someone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, is that true?
Who are you waiting for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are!!
I've been waiting for you two!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, Nene!
Is that who you were waiting for, Miku?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not really morning anymore, you know?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, aren't you gonna give them that thing? That's why we're here, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here you are, Miku!
These are the Print Stickers we took during the gaming tournament!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You entered into the gaming tournament this arcade held in order to win the tickets they had up on offer as the prize, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. A lot happened during it, but we managed to win in the end.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's great! Good for you both, Nene, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! And because we won, we all get to go see that show together♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, your pictures turned out so cute!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, these faces drawn above Nene...
Did you draw Miku, Tsukasa and Rui?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You worked really hard on that because you want to include these with their tickets as a present, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair! Doodling on pictures sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna try doing that too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Then, why don't we all visit that arcade together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, I'm not sure that's going to work since they won't be able to actually hold the pen to draw.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
I couldn't do anything at all when I tried!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear... I was interested in trying it out as well... What if we all wished really hard? Would that help?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... We can doodle on you if it's in our dreams, MEIKO. You won't be mad, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, just what exactly are you “dreaming” of doing to me?! I mean, of course I'll be mad if you were to draw on me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you liked it when I drew a flower on your cheek the other day, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A flower on my cheek?
Yes, it was cute, so I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there anything we can do about this, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know how you feel, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... We could do something very similar if I brought a tablet over...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Taking pictures and doodling all over them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been trying to come up with ideas that might get more people to come to the park and wrote it all down in a notebook...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu!
Can I have a look at the notebook you just showed Rui?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, yeah...
Whoa, Miku, you're a genius! That might just work!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lemme head back home and grab it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, what were you whispering to her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
You'll just have to wait until Emu gets back☆
